title: Shared places
info: Parks, libraries, classrooms, and roads are shared. Everyone uses them.
Leave a place as nice as you found it. Quiet voices belong in a library.

questions.q: A library works best when people
options: eat sticky food on the books
is the park's job to enjoy

questions.q: A queue, or line, is fair because
options: the tallest person always goes first
more than one person depends on it
